security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Safety-first unified manager over existing package managers
bundle.longDescription: UniManage is a unified, safety-first front end for the package managers already on your system (apt, snap, flatpak, npm, pipx and more). It lists installed packages, shows updates and dependencies, and changes nothing without a preview and explicit confirmation. Privileged operations go through polkit; UniManage never sees your password.
